Why ZERO

Built for Better Daily Habits.

ZERO gives customers a few clear ways to use the brand: sweeten drinks at home, carry sweetness anywhere, and add functional products to daily routines.

Better-tasting sweetness

ZERO Syrup is positioned as a smoother alternative to the bitter aftertaste many customers associate with stevia-based products.

Portable convenience

ZERO Drops sweeten a drink with just 5 to 7 drops, giving customers a format that can travel anywhere.

Functional support

ZFIT expands beyond sweetness with prebiotic fiber syrup and ACVS for customers focused on overall wellness.

Local mission

The company mission is simple: make Indonesia healthier by making healthy choices easier.

Company Info

Built by a Focused Team.

ZERO Foods Indonesia was founded in 2024 and runs from Yogyakarta with a team focused on product development, public health, and day-to-day operations.

01. Founders

Brent Vincent and Giri Gusman founded ZERO, with Branch Vincent leading much of the brand and marketing execution.

02. Address

ZERO is based at Jl. Jombor Tegal No.124 A, Jombor Lor, Sinduadi, Kec. Mlati, Kabupaten Sleman, DI Yogyakarta 55284.

03. Contact

Customers can reach the brand through WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube under the zerofoods.id identity.
